title: Python Private Server Client Gap Map

cleanroom.scope: Synthetic protocol foundation; no production adapter or integration

game_startup.game_requirement: OpenKey validation, master data loading, configuration

gaps.detail: No server-side endpoint validates OpenKey (IsOpen, OpenVersion, OpenDate, OpenTime). Game reads OpenKey locally from disk; server not involved.
Server has resource.py and game_data.py routes but game-side master-data contract is undefined from static evidence.
version.py exists but is not confirmed to match the game's HTTP contract.

player_card_session.game_requirement: Card scan, player identification, session creation via NESYS pipe

gaps.detail: Game card flow goes through NESYS pipe (TestNesysCardRead, CallbackNesysCompleteCardStatus). No local pipe adapter exists.
player.py exists but game-side payload contract is undefined.

matching.game_requirement: HTTP match ID generation + HTTP matching server + TCP matching entry/cancel

gaps.detail: matching.py exists but is not confirmed to match BindHttpMatchingServer contract; payload unknown.
TCP server at :6666 exists but its handler dispatch (MESSAGE_TYPE_MAP) is built from synthetic/protocol evidence, not confirmed game-side command IDs.
No confirmed match-id-generation behavior tied to BindHttpMatchingMatchIdGenerate.

battle_coordination.game_requirement: TCP battle commands (EntryBurst, ChangeBurstMode, CancelBurst, BurstUpdate, BurstRejectPlayer, BurstSelect)

gaps.detail: No confirmed game-side [Client->Gameserver] battle command handlers with proven payload semantics.
Protobuf serialization confirmed present, but specific battle message definitions are not verified from the game client.
No confirmed result-submission route matching BindHttpFestResult with proven request/response contract.
Error handling exists synthetically but not aligned to confirmed game-side error callback semantics.
RequestNesysReconnect runs through the NESYS path; no adapter.

required_evidence_before_completion.notice: Per G19 rules, no feature is marked complete without all three: (1) confirmed client request, (2) required server response, (3) state advancement/completion behavior.

analysis_method: Comparison of game-side evidence (static analysis) against deployed Python server surface
notes: Current server exposes HTTP :4001, proxy :80, TCP :6666 but none are confirmed to match the game's actual contracts
Matching, battle, and result are NOT complete merely because listeners/handlers exist
No confirmed client request/response/state-advancement evidence exists for the current server
Local adapter required for NESYS pipe card flow
